capability: Plant faults on purpose to prove the checker looks
title: Test the gate by breaking it.

hook.picture: Close: the whale walks a line of cards through a gate. The gate glows pass for every card, even one with a visibly crooked join.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The checker said all clear. Was it even looking?
problem_in_viewer_words.who: a researcher reading a green test report

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: a row of gates, all glowing pass. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, a crooked card slides through unnoticed.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: A check that never fails tells you nothing.

stakes.body: A checker that cannot fail gives false comfort, and the gaps reach readers.

solution_hint: Break it on purpose. See if it notices.

metaphor.body: The checker is a gate. The whale bends cards on purpose and fires them at it, and each bounce earns a tick, so a gate that never stops anything is exposed.

steps.picture: The whale takes a good card and bends its join on purpose, a planted fault, then sends it at the gate.
steps.words: Break it on purpose. See if it notices.

steps.picture: The gate closes English Red on the bent card and it bounces back. A tick lands beside the gate.
steps.sound: A stop tone, then a tick.

steps.picture: Push-in: the whale plants a different fault, a card with a missing join. The gate closes again and a second tick lands.
steps.sound: A second stop tone, a second tick.

steps.picture: A row of planted cards, each with its own tick, lines up beside the gate. A label slides on: negative tests.
steps.words: Planted faults are called negative tests.
steps.sound: Ticks in a row, like a ledger.

real_case.claim: sheaf-knowledge-studio passes 33/33 negative mutation self-tests, and all 3 builds clear 30/30 binary gates.

honest_limit.picture: Push to the end of the row: a card with a new kind of fault (wrong colour, joins fine) passes every gate. Nobody planted that kind.
honest_limit.words: A new kind of fault walked through.

not_this.body: Catching planted faults is not catching all.

ending_pattern.body: The crooked card that once slid through is fired at the same gate and bounces off red, while the reader pod answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: The crooked card that slid through the glowing gate in bar 1 is stopped at the same gate.

end_belief.body: Trust a check only after it fails once.

score_self.reason: Testing the checker is a researcher-grade idea with a clear picture and real 33/33 numbers. Risk: "negative tests" is new jargon in this series, and the wrong-colour limit echoes the gate film.
